_comment: Hand-maintained mapping from Google Cloud's public Speech-to-Text pricing page to
pricing.json entries. No model list is held here: the page lists the prices, and the
keys are made from what each row states.
Each price table sits under a heading naming its API version, matched by
`version_heading`, and is read if its first header cells are `header`, word for word.
The columns after the price, one per commitment plan (Gemini Enterprise Flexible
Savings Plan, 1 or 3 years), are not read. A table headed another way is reported.
Every price is per minute of audio, `field`: '$0.016 / 1 minute, per 1 month /
account'. A cell in any other unit fails the run. A free tier is not an entry.
